sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate represents the ship-owned relationship or formula operand proving that the maximum torque occurring during the speed drop is used for load consideration.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The true standstill branch only requires presence of the maximum-torque value and omits the intended-service power consequence and the requirement that this maximum torque be used for load consideration. Require nltl:intendedServicePowerAdequacy with the verified inadequate polarity when standstill is reached, and locate the canonical property for the load/design torque actually used; constrain that value to the maximum occurring torque using the appropriate derived-value tolerance rather than a presence-only or exact-decimal check.
